description: This file contains C source code implementing Lua script integrations for configuration handling in a web server project, including functions for converting parameters, managing dynamic hashes, handling actions and setup, and loading Lua configuration scripts.

methods.name: liValue * lua_params_to_value(liServer * srv,lua_State * L)
methods.description: Converts Lua parameters from the stack into a server-side liValue list object.

methods.name: int _lua_dynamic_hash_index_call(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Calls a wrapped Lua function with server, worker, and key parameters.

methods.name: int _lua_dynamic_hash_index(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Creates a Lua userdata with a metatable supporting nested hash-style access via __index and __call.

methods.name: void lua_push_dynamic_hash(liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,lua_State * L,LuaWrapper wrapper)
methods.description: Pushes a dynamic hash table onto the Lua stack, associated with server, worker, and a wrapper function.

methods.name: int li_lua_config_handle_server_action(liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,lua_State * L,const char * key)
methods.description: Handles server action configuration calls from Lua, creating and pushing an action.

methods.name: void li_lua_push_action_table(liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,lua_State * L)
methods.description: Pushes a table of server actions into Lua environment.

methods.name: int li_lua_config_handle_server_setup(liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,lua_State * L,const char * key)
methods.description: Handles server setup configuration from Lua, performing setup based on parameters.

methods.name: void li_lua_push_setup_table(liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,lua_State * L)
methods.description: Pushes a setup table into Lua environment for configuration purposes.

methods.name: gboolean li_config_lua_load(liLuaState * LL,liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,const gchar * filename,liAction ** pact,gboolean allow_setup,liValue * args)
methods.description: Loads a Lua configuration script file, executes it, and extracts actions for server configuration.

ctags.name: LuaWrapper
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,lua_State * L,const char * key)

ctags.name: li_config_lua_load
ctags.signature: (liLuaState * LL,liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk,const gchar * filename,liAction ** pact,gboolean allow_setup,liValue * args)

ctags.name: lua_push_dynamic_hash
ctags.pattern: /^static void lua_push_dynamic_hash(liServer *srv, liWorker *wrk, lua_State *L, LuaWrapper wrapper/
